title: 88Vape Original Menthol 10ml E-Liquid
description: Menthol from 88Vape is a pure, clean and endlessly refreshing treat for menthol lovers. Perfect for when you just want to chill, this bracing flavour brings a rush of crisp freshness with every puff. This e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their High PG e-liquids are suitable for most kinds of vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss. Please note: that the 11mg & 16mg nicotine strengths contain 30VG/70PG.
